notes.title: Optimalization Update
notes.content:
New Graphics Settings and fixes to ensure the game runs better and smoother, especially on older machines
[list]
    [*]Added settings option for scaling resolution
    [*]New Low settings for shadows and post-process
    [*]Updated settings for better texture resolution scaling and shadow quality
    [*]New Level Detail setting that removes unnecessary small objects, ground clutter and decals to save rendering power 
    [*]Fixed few bugs causing random FPS drops
    [*]Updated and cleaned up static meshes that were causing some problems
    [*]Lighting and shadows optimalization 
[/list]

notes.title: Performance update
notes.content:
Bigger update that improves overall performance, smoother loading and unloading and helps with some of the fps drops.
[list]
    [*]Updated lighting and level details
    [*]Some minor texture changes
    [*]Improved level loading/unloading
    [*]Few changes to the scene transitions
    [*]Small level design changes
    [*]Fixed few bugs that were causing fps drop in certain scenes
    [*]Fixed bug that was causing performance problems in the game menu
[/list]

notes.title: Old Update from 20.2.
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Achievements added
    [*]New camera system - this should fix problems with the camera lag and also make all movement a lot smoother (If you still have problems with camera, make sure Vsync is not the problem)
    [*]Easy mode added - if you're not here for the adventure game part, don't want to run around searching for clues or you just get stuck, you can now display hints that will highlight clues and important objects when you get near them. It affects crime scenes and most of the puzzles as well. This will not tell you how to solve the puzzles, just point you in the right direction and show you which objects in the scene are important.
    [*]Fixed audio bugs
    [*]Fixed collision problems
    [*]Fixed rest of the bugs with character movement
[/list]

notes.title: Update, fixes and more...
notes.content:
First bigger update is finally done. I'm very sorry it took so long, Steam was acting strange this week. Hopefully everything should be working fine now.
[list] 
[*]Added more autosaves, especially during crime scenes and before some of the puzzles
[*]Fixed problems with reloading the level
[*]There were some changes to the crime scenes, making sure the nametags and evidence outlines work properly and simplify it a little bit 
[*]Few changes to some of the puzzles to make them less confusing
[*]Fixed the body glitches
[*]I deleted few of the less interesting puzzles to make the game flow a little better
[/list]
